insights.title: Portfolio tracks 94 raw materials
insights.text: The tracked universe spans 94 raw materials this cycle — averaging +7.8% week-on-week.

insights.title: FEED ADDITIVE spikes as Corn DDG CIF slides
insights.text: FEED ADDITIVE posted the sharpest weekly gain at +320.4%, while Corn DDG CIF fell -34.1% WoW; 19 of 91 priced materials moved more than ±10% week-on-week.

insights.title: LIMESTONE POWDER cheapest, FEED SUPPLEMENT (POWDER) most expensive
insights.text: LIMESTONE POWDER remains the lowest-priced tracked material at roughly $118/MT, while FEED SUPPLEMENT (POWDER) is the most expensive at about $5,822/MT.

insights.title: 52 materials flagged for supplier review, 6 confirmed high-cost
insights.text: CORN FOB, SOYMEAL CIF Hi-Pro, ANIMAL FEED, MONO CALCIUM PHOSPHATE (MCP), DICALCIUM PHOSPHATE (DCP), FEED ADDITIVE carry confirmed High Cost signals versus alternative sourcing, while 52 additional materials are flagged for supplier review.

insights.title: 18 materials still lack a confirmed origin
insights.text: 18 of the tracked materials have no confirmed Akij sourcing country on file yet — largely the newly added feed premix, supplement, and specialty meal lines.
